title: Otavalo Market in Ecuador: How to Visit South America’s Largest Market – The Pedal Project

facts.fact: The page says the weather in Otavalo is close to 60F (15C) year-round.
facts.quote: The weather in Otavalo, Ecuador is close to 60F (15C)degrees year-round

facts.fact: The page says Otavalo sits at an elevation of 8,345 feet (2,543 m) above sea level.
facts.quote: elevation of 8,345 feet (2,543 m) above sea level

facts.fact: The page says the Otavalo market is held at the Plaza de los Ponchos every day, 365 days a year.
facts.quote: The market is held at the Plaza de los Ponchos every day, 365 days a year.

facts.fact: The page says the Otavalo market hours are from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.
facts.quote: The hours are from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

facts.fact: The page recommends Saturday and Wednesday early in the morning as the best days to visit, which it describes as market days with more vendors.
facts.quote: The best days to visit the Otavalo market are Saturday and Wednesday early in the morning.

facts.fact: The page states Otavalo is about 65 miles (105 km) slightly northeast of Quito, in the province of Imbabura.
facts.quote: Otavalo is located 65 miles (105 km) slightly Northeast of the capital city of Quito, in the province of Imbabura.

facts.fact: The page says the trip from Quito to Otavalo takes about 2 hours.
facts.quote: It should take you about 2 hours to get there, with one of these options:

facts.fact: The page lists the public bus from Quito to Otavalo at around $3.00.
facts.quote: **Bus (around $3.00)** – Take a public bus or taxi to the Carcelén bus terminal

facts.fact: The page lists day tours from Quito to Otavalo at $50-$100.
The page lists car rental from Quito at $25/day or more.
facts.quote: **Car ($25/day +)** – It’s easy to [rent a car online]

facts.fact: The page says a taxi from the town's main bus station to the market costs around $1.
facts.quote: you’ll need to get a taxi (around $1) to the market.

facts.fact: The page says the ride from the main bus station to the market in Otavalo takes no more than 5-10 minutes.
facts.quote: The town is really small, so your ride won’t take more than 5-10 minutes.

facts.fact: The page says the drive from the Quito airport to the city is about 40 minutes.
facts.quote: If you’re staying in Quito, it’s a 40-minute drive from the airport.

facts.fact: The page states buses depart from the Carcelén bus terminal in Quito to Otavalo every day, and no advance ticket purchase is required.
facts.quote: There are buses departing from the Carcelén bus terminal in Quito to Otavalo, Ecuador every day. You don’t have to buy a ticket in advance.

facts.fact: The page describes Otavalo as known for having the largest market in South America, a claim the author repeats without a cited source.
facts.quote: Otavalo is known around the world as the home of the largest market in South America.
